items.prompt: A plain roadside-motel conference room near the Gulf of Finland at dusk: rows of chairs facing a simple table with a cloth and two candlesticks, tall pines and a grey sea visible through the window. A few men in dark suits from behind.

alt.ru: Конференц-зал придорожного мотеля у Финского залива в сумерках: ряды стульев перед столом со скатертью и двумя подсвечниками, за окном сосны и серое море.
alt.en: A roadside-motel conference room by the Gulf of Finland at dusk: rows of chairs before a table with a cloth and two candlesticks, pines and a grey sea outside.
alt.pt: Uma sala de conferências de um motel de estrada junto ao golfo da Finlândia ao entardecer: filas de cadeiras diante de uma mesa com toalha e dois castiçais, pinheiros e mar cinzento lá fora.
alt.es: Una sala de conferencias de un motel de carretera junto al golfo de Finlandia al anochecer: filas de sillas ante una mesa con mantel y dos candelabros, pinos y un mar gris fuera.
